examples.description: Cut pauses of half a second or more, leaving 100ms at each

description: Cut every silent pause the transcript found OUT OF THE FOOTAGE, keeping a little breathing room at each one. This is the real edit, not a transcript cleanup: the video gets shorter. Needs a transcript first (transcribe). Not undoable.

keep_ms.description: Breathing room left at the end of each pause. 0 makes speech run together.

min_silence_ms.description: Only cut pauses at least this long. Below ~400ms you are cutting natural speech rhythm.
